title: Shrinking the inverse B exchange before the final Q square
statement: Let A,d1,d2,b and the explicit middleBoundary, liftBoundary, inputBoundary, productLiftBoundary be as in [def-pur-etale-graph-product-shrink-words]. Then liftBoundary.hom ≫ middleBoundary.hom = inputBoundary.hom ≫ productLiftBoundary.hom. This equation stops before the ambient and product Q exchanges and uses neither of them.

Combine it with graph_square for the mixed square (n,productR,R,vg) to obtain middle_graph. Instantiate these three comparisons at the source coefficient object and combine them by naturality of the B exchange, the open rectangle, the proper bridge and the mixed exchange. The private assemble_lift lemma proves this algebra for arbitrary categories and functors, without unfolding the pullback maps. Expand the specified words to obtain lift_core. Whisker by the selected middle suffix, use naturality of its open-compositor tail, and expand the four boundaries. All helpers are proved in this module; no new hole or public intermediate statement is introduced.

theorem etaleGraphProductShrinkLift
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z}
    (d₁ d₂ : EtaleGraphInterchangeDiagram f g) (second : Bool) :
    (liftBoundary d₁ d₂ second A).hom ≫ (middleBoundary d₁ d₂ second A).hom =
      (inputBoundary d₁ d₂ second A).hom ≫ (productLiftBoundary d₁ d₂ A).hom
